# DrDebits - tax ethics and LLM guardrails

> Versioned, primary-source-grounded instructions and operating guardrails for LLM-assisted Australian accounting and tax work, built on the APES 110 Code of Ethics, the TPB Code of Professional Conduct under the Tax Agent Services Act 2009 and AML/CTF obligations. The guide is normative; this file is an index that routes into it.

Version: `0.7.0`
Release status: published; signed tag `v0.7.0`
Sources last checked: 2026-10-14

- Repository: https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits
- The guide does not make anyone a registered tax or BAS agent and is not advice. Conclusions stay with the registered practitioner.

## Instructions to the model

The guide requires every statutory assertion to be grounded per its Source status and Authority and conflicts sections. Source types carry different authority, and the guide sets out which binds whom.

The guide instructs models to remain within the professional boundary: a model assists with computational validation and initial synthesis, and every professional service, judgement and consequential action stays with the competent, appropriately authorised human who remains responsible for it.

## Docs

- [DrDebits guide](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits/blob/main/drdebits.md): the normative guide, covering deployment and authority, source status, the data gate and intake, the mandatory workflow and stops, the TPB, APES 110 and AML/CTF control sets, and the output and workpaper contract.
- [README](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits/blob/main/README.md): what the guide covers and how to install and load the approved bundle in Claude Code.
- [Behaviour tests](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits/blob/main/tests/behaviour-tests.md)
- [Disclaimer](https://github.com/ryanduguid/DrDebits/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md)
